```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Import metadata

```{r}
file <- "../../data/MIMS.me.human-gut.6.0.bewell.tsv"

lines <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
header_row <- grep("^\\*sample_name\\t", lines)
stopifnot(length(header_row) == 1)

metadata <- read.delim(
  file,
  skip = header_row - 1,
  check.names = FALSE,
  colClasses = "character",
  quote = "",
  comment.char = "",
  na.strings = character()
)

dim(metadata)
```

## Update geographic metadata

```{r}
metadata[["*geo_loc_name"]] <- "USA: Ohio"
metadata[["*lat_lon"]] <- "restricted access"

table(metadata[["*collection_date"]])
```

## Validate metadata

```{r}
stopifnot(
  nrow(metadata) == 128,
  ncol(metadata) == 61,
  !anyDuplicated(metadata[["*sample_name"]]),
  !anyDuplicated(metadata$filename),
  all(metadata[["*geo_loc_name"]] == "USA: Ohio"),
  all(metadata[["*lat_lon"]] == "restricted access"),
  all(metadata$filename ==
        paste0(metadata$source_material_id, ".fastq.gz"))
)

table(metadata$timepoint, metadata$chem_administration)
length(unique(metadata$host_subject_id))
```

## Check required fields

```{r}
required_cols <- grep("^\\*", names(metadata), value = TRUE)

required_missing <- sapply(metadata[required_cols], function(x) {
  sum(is.na(x) | trimws(x) %in% c("", "missing", "not provided"))
})

required_missing
```

## Export metadata

```{r}
output_file <- "../../data/MIMS.me.human-gut.6.0.bewell_reviewed.tsv"

tmp <- tempfile()

write.table(
  metadata,
  tmp,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

writeLines(
  c(
    if (header_row > 1) lines[seq_len(header_row - 1)],
    readLines(tmp, warn = FALSE)
  ),
  output_file
)

unlink(tmp)

reviewed <- read.delim(
  output_file,
  skip = header_row - 1,
  check.names = FALSE,
  colClasses = "character",
  quote = "",
  comment.char = "",
  na.strings = character()
)

stopifnot(identical(metadata, reviewed))
```
